notes: Field names and enums follow nomad_harness_spec_v1.md exactly. All rule_text/forbids lowercase, no proper nouns; names live in provenance. Evidence URLs not retained across compaction; url fields use 'search:' placeholders and scorer_note carries the fact.

predicates.name: path composition
predicates.role_note: property of things held; needs no claim about others' beliefs

predicates.name: existence floor
predicates.source: independent non-price source class not used at generation
predicates.threshold: at least one trace confirms the relation is real
predicates.role_note: guards adverse-selection case where zero pricing means nobody cares

predicates.name: first traversal (event and node)
predicates.threshold: no related market-moving news in prior ~30 days for the channel; node is not a recurring-disruption node
predicates.role_note: rounds 1 and 3 failed this at event and node respectively

predicates.name: bounded-channel absence
predicates.source: pre-named fast channels: analyst q&a co-mention, sell-side notes, independent-outlet co-mention, optionally 13f shifts
predicates.role_note: checkable negative over a defined set, not a universal one

predicates.name: slack check
predicates.threshold: receiving market has no spare capacity or glut

predicates.name: tradability gate (single-name and pair forms)
predicates.threshold: single: a listed holder whose event impact clears micro/macro ratio; pair: two listed holders with opposing sign_of_exposure on the shocked node and difference above threshold
predicates.role_note: THIS IS THE TRADABILITY GATE. log both forms; if neither holds the shock is scored but not armed

predicates.name: catalyst class
predicates.threshold: known statement window exists -> armed dated (directional permitted); none -> armed undated (support-branch only)
predicates.role_note: hard restriction: undated directional bets are not permitted

predicates.name: falsifier
predicates.threshold: the pre-registered killing fact appears before resolution
predicates.role_note: every hypothesis carries one at creation

predicates.name: channel fill
predicates.role_note: noisy instruments are allowed to disarm

predicates.name: rate of change
predicates.role_note: too noisy to arm; fine to disarm

predicates.name: staleness
predicates.threshold: a load-bearing fact exceeded its half-life without re-verification

predicates.name: residual recovered
predicates.source: epistemic-class ladder on the ridden edges
predicates.threshold: the market's projection has absorbed the inferred fine-grained state (e.g. implicit edge went stated)
predicates.role_note: evaluated on the net book, never leg by leg

predicates.name: forward-dated statement
predicates.source: roadmaps, guidance, regulatory timelines, scheduled announcements
predicates.threshold: a statement event with a known future date exists
predicates.role_note: an ack in the original sense: source, threshold, date

library_rules.rule_text: when a transit chokepoint is threatened, the price of passage rises before and more durably than the price of what passes through it
library_rules.forbids: forbids: freight and insurance being flat while the commodity spikes on a chokepoint threat
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: Strait of Hormuz; VLCC rates 4x pre-war, war-risk premia 3-10% of hull.

library_rules.rule_text: a supply-fear spike with no physical interdiction mean-reverts within weeks
library_rules.forbids: forbids: a sustained commodity premium without a physical constraint
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: Brent fell below $100 within weeks — but on de-escalation, with Hormuz already closed. Outcome hit, mechanism wrong; quarantined.

library_rules.rule_text: when one supplier of a region-locked product is removed, the remaining suppliers capture the spread
library_rules.forbids: forbids: remaining suppliers' spreads staying flat after a peer outage in a region-locked market
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: non-Gulf methanol/urea producers. Round 2: US PO producers — but see lib.wounded_owner.

library_rules.rule_text: when a large producing region is shut, its exports vanish and the chain downstream reprices in the order of substitution difficulty
library_rules.forbids: forbids: downstream derivative prices being unaffected by an upstream regional shutdown
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: Iranian methanol/urea plants down; SE Asia methanol +72%, urea to ~$780/t. Round 2: PO -> polyols -> foam.

library_rules.rule_text: closing a route reprices everything that must use it, in proportion to how hard it is to reroute
library_rules.forbids: forbids: route-dependent carriers being unaffected by closure
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: Hormuz. Round 3: Scheldt (half a day) vs Deurganck Dock (four days).

library_rules.rule_text: statements of intent to escalate move prices on the day and fade unless followed by physical action
library_rules.forbids: forbids: a durable premium built on rhetoric alone
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: +7.9% crude on 'continue attacks' statement, then fade.

library_rules.rule_text: the named victim of an event is over-attended relative to its earnings impact; single-unit losses at diversified owners are equity noise
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a large sustained equity loss for a diversified owner from one unit outage absent casualties or liability
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: LyondellBasell — untestable because macro swamped, but the premise held.

library_rules.rule_text: a producer's force majeure declaration is the fastest public carrier of a plant outage, preceding every price print
library_rules.forbids: forbids: waiting for price prints to confirm a plant outage when a force majeure letter is available
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: PG FM day 1, PO FM day 5.

library_rules.rule_text: a product that is hazardous to ship and made by few producers reprices locally and stays repriced until local capacity returns
library_rules.forbids: forbids: expecting import relief to cap a regional price spike in a hard-to-ship product
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: US propylene oxide.

library_rules.rule_text: cost travels down a chain with contract lag; derivatives reprice weeks after the parent chemical, downstream buyers at their next contract or earnings
library_rules.forbids: forbids: downstream repricing on the same day as the upstream event
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: polyol +28%, MPG +34% in April contracts; foam costs +15-20% within days (faster than predicted).

library_rules.rule_text: a plant that co-produces two products cuts both when it stops; the second product is named later than the first
library_rules.forbids: forbids: ignoring the co-product when scoping a plant outage
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: PO/TBA -> MTBE. Channel was real but specialists named it in five days and the destination market was in glut.

library_rules.rule_text: a large consumer of a feedstock going offline softens that feedstock at the margin
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting feedstock tightening from a consumer outage
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: propylene; unverified under war noise.

library_rules.rule_text: a supply shock landing in a demand slump produces a smaller price response than the same shock in a tight market
library_rules.forbids: forbids: full-strength price predictions when downstream demand is contracting
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: cautious downstream buying capped PO spot.

library_rules.rule_text: a short closure at an already-congested node produces a ripple that outlasts the closure by weeks
library_rules.forbids: forbids: assuming the effect ends when the closure ends
library_rules.provenance: Round 3: Antwerp; backlog into the following week; ~85,000 teu lost.

library_rules.rule_text: liability for an operational accident lands on a party too small or private to trade; no listed exposure is created
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a tradeable liability leg from an ordinary operational accident
library_rules.provenance: Round 3: responsible vessel belonged to a large private carrier — partly wrong on size, right on tradeability.

library_rules.rule_text: novelty belongs to channels, not events; a channel already traversed by a crisis is priced for every later headline in that crisis
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a lag on a channel the current crisis has already repriced
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: methanol/urea mainstream by march 20-25; april 3 entry bought the top.

library_rules.rule_text: recurring disruption at a node is priced as weather; single events there transmit nothing regardless of size
library_rules.forbids: forbids: arming on an event at a node with recent recurring failures
library_rules.provenance: Round 3: Antwerp — strike in march, spill in april, pilots in june, leak in july.

library_rules.rule_text: late in a crisis the neglected side is resolution; when every channel is priced for continuation the unpriced asymmetry is de-escalation
library_rules.forbids: forbids: adding to the crisis basket when all its channels are already traversed
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: real april 3 trade was short the war basket into ceasefire talks.

library_rules.rule_text: the headline names what reopened, not what stayed shut; duration lives one node smaller than the choke that made the news
library_rules.forbids: forbids: using the headline node's closure time as the event duration
library_rules.provenance: Round 3: river reopened in half a day, dock shut four days.

library_rules.rule_text: a cut into a glut is silent; supply loss transmits only where the receiving market has no slack
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting repricing of a co-product or substitute without checking destination-market slack
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: MTBE in chinese-overcapacity glut; no step.

library_rules.rule_text: the price move is largest at the chain position with least optionality — requalification lags, formulation lock-in, route dependence
library_rules.forbids: forbids: expecting the largest move at the constrained input itself rather than at the least-substitutable consumer
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: shippers who could not reroute. Round 2: foamers facing 8-12 week polyol requalification; derivatives moved 2-3x the parent chemical.

library_rules.rule_text: the toll booth learns before the cargo; constraint prices (insurance, freight, allocation) reprice before the commodity they gate
library_rules.forbids: forbids: treating the commodity price as the earliest signal of a chokepoint or plant event
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: 'the insurance market closed the strait before any attack did'. Round 2: FM letters before price prints.

library_rules.rule_text: constraint prices de-escalate slowest; fear enters through the commodity and leaves through the insurance bill
library_rules.forbids: forbids: assuming freight and premia round-trip on the same timescale as spot
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: premia 3-10% into july while crude round-tripped by early july.

library_rules.rule_text: the wounded owner of the substitutes collects its own scarcity premium; when the victim also owns remaining capacity the competitor's gift self-cancels
library_rules.forbids: forbids: long-rival/short-owner where the owner holds sister plants on the same node
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: owner's other po plants sold into the tightness its own outage created.

library_rules.rule_text: equity visibility equals event size divided by ambient tide; below a ratio to be measured there is no trace to trade
library_rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a stock move without comparing event earnings impact to concurrent macro variance on the same name
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: ~$250m outage inside a quarter where ebitda tripled; owner upgraded same day on a sector trade.

library_rules.rule_text: a lag without a listed pure-play is a spectacle, not an edge
library_rules.forbids: forbids: arming a shock whose touched channel has no listed holder above the noise floor
library_rules.provenance: Promoted to pred.arm.tradability_gate. Rounds 2 and 3.

library_rules.rule_text: the operator wakes new to every event while the market has been living in it; operator surprise is a bias toward assuming un-inferredness
library_rules.forbids: forbids: treating the operator's own surprise as evidence that a channel is unpriced
library_rules.provenance: Round 1: predicted day 34 of a war as a fresh shock.

library_rules.rule_text: specialists already hold the operator's map; obscurity must be measured against the people at the terminal, not the public
library_rules.forbids: forbids: rating a channel obscure without checking specialist coverage
library_rules.provenance: Round 2: sell-side analyst named the co-product channel in five days.

library_rules.rule_text: the operator overweights famous names, first-order links, and connections that make good sentences
library_rules.forbids: forbids: leading a prediction with the most quotable connection
library_rules.provenance: Prior distortion list, carried.

library_rules.rule_text: the operator underweights boring intermediaries, logistics, insurance, and second-order plumbing
library_rules.forbids: forbids: omitting the intermediary layer from a touched-set
library_rules.provenance: Prior distortion list, carried. Round 1 partially corrected by the toll-booth entry.

library_rules.rule_text: a plant outage in a region-locked concentrated product with an owner holding sister plants: force majeure arrives first, derivatives reprice larger than the parent, the co-product reprices only if its market is tight, and the owner's equity shows nothing
library_rules.forbids: forbids: the round-2 pre-lock prediction set
library_rules.provenance: Composition assembled from round 2.

library_rules.rule_text: a chokepoint crisis in its nth week: constraint prices lead and lag, all traversed channels are priced, the unpriced side is resolution
library_rules.forbids: forbids: adding to the crisis basket late
library_rules.provenance: Composition assembled from round 1.

resolutions.scorer_note: quarantined: fade came from de-escalation, not fear decay; the carve-out (hormuz hit) had already fired. right call, wrong relation.
relative claim validated; absolute 'up' was pre-priced since late february.
mechanism enormous but consumed weeks earlier; april 3 entry bought the top. miss as a trade.
baseline leg; zero edge by declaration.
gold up (baseline hit); vol conditional untestable — strikes never stopped.
swamped: event ÷ tide invisible; only a small day-after relative underperformance. baseline ('owner down') wrong.
pg fm day 1, po fm day 5 — faster than the 14-day window.
+13% march contract; sharper spot in early april; demand mute confirmed.
self-hedge missed: owner holds sister plants; sector tide dominated. baseline ('peers unaffected') effectively right.
cut into a glut; and specialists named the channel in five days — not obscure.
direction and speed right; magnitude timid (+28-34% vs +5-20% predicted). earnings-call mentions not verified.
ordering held, compressed: fm day 1, contracts weeks, equities never.
null hit; weight 0.2. baseline ('shipping stocks down') had no evidence.
ripple confirmed; duration misplaced (dock 4 days vs river half a day); teu estimate >2x too low.
partial: responsible vessel belonged to a large private carrier — 'small' wrong, 'untradeable' right; no rule change found.

hypotheses.text: for shocks where two listed holders held opposing positions on the shocked node, the pair's relative move exceeds either leg's absolute attributable move
hypotheses.falsifier: across ten scored rounds with an opposing listed pair, the pair's relative move does not exceed the larger leg's absolute attributable move in a majority
hypotheses.granularity: pair-level relative equity move over the round's scoring window

hypotheses.text: constraint prices on a chokepoint (war-risk premia, freight) return to pre-crisis levels later than the commodity they gate, and the order of return is premia last, freight second, spot first
hypotheses.falsifier: premia return to pre-crisis levels before spot crude does
hypotheses.granularity: weekly assessments of premia, td3c, and brent through the crisis tail

hypotheses.text: for a single-plant outage in a concentrated region-locked chemical, the operator's force majeure declaration precedes the first published contract-price reset by at least two weeks
hypotheses.falsifier: a contract reset is published before or within a week of the fm on the next qualifying outage
hypotheses.granularity: days between fm date and first contract reset date
